### Sobras

Comprobemos el resultado obtenido con <code>gap</code>.

::: {.sage}
<script type="text/x-sage">
RelToDotNS:=function(uni, rel,labels)

  local r, output, out, i, str;

  str:=function(s)
    return Concatenation("\"",String(s),"\"");
  end;

  out:="";
  output:=OutputTextString(out,true);
  AppendTo(output,"graph  NSGraph{");
  for i in [1..Length(uni)] do
    AppendTo(output,i," [label=",str(labels[i]),"];\n");
  od;
  for r in rel do
    AppendTo(output,Position(uni,r[1])," -- ",Position(uni,r[2]),";\n");
  od;
  AppendTo(output,"}");
  CloseStream(output);
  return out;
end;
</script>
:::


Un poco después uso `a` de nuevo.

::: {.sage}
<script type="text/x-sage">
Print(RelToDotNS([1,2,3],[[1,2],[1,3]],[1,2,3]));
</script>
:::

## La salida

y esto produce

```{dot}
graph  NSGraph{1 [label="1"];
2 [label="2"];
3 [label="3"];
1 -- 2;
1 -- 3;
}
```
